filters.label: Product Category
filters.query: SELECT DISTINCT category AS value, category AS label FROM products ORDER BY category

cards.title: Total Revenue
cards.query: SELECT CONCAT('$', FORMAT(SUM(total_amount), 0)) AS value FROM orders WHERE order_date >= CURDATE() - INTERVAL 30 DAY

cards.title: Avg Order Value
cards.query: SELECT CONCAT('$', FORMAT(AVG(total_amount), 2)) AS value FROM orders WHERE order_date >= CURDATE() - INTERVAL 30 DAY

cards.title: Orders (30d)
cards.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM orders WHERE order_date >= CURDATE() - INTERVAL 30 DAY

cards.title: Active Customers
cards.query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS value FROM orders WHERE order_date >= CURDATE() - INTERVAL 30 DAY

cards.title: Monthly Revenue
cards.query: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(order_date, '%Y-%m') AS label, SUM(total_amount) AS value FROM orders GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(order_date, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY label

cards.title: Revenue by Category
cards.query: SELECT p.category AS label, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS value FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY value DESC

cards.title: Orders by Category
cards.query: SELECT p.category AS label, COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id) AS value FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY value DESC

cards.title: Latest 20 Orders
cards.query: SELECT order_id AS 'Order ID', customer_name AS 'Customer', total_amount AS 'Total', order_date AS 'Date', status AS 'Status' FROM orders ORDER BY order_date DESC LIMIT 20
